content: Maria, do you like to read?
Yeah. But right now I'm really busy with work, so I don't have alot of time to read. But when I'm on vacation or whenever I have free time, I like to read books.
I like to read novels the most, but I also like biographies. And I enjoy reading about teaching practices, so that I can become a better teacher. And a little bit of history, too.
And what about concerts? Do you enjoy going to concerts?
I don't go to music concerts very often, but I like to go see musicals and I also like to go to sporting events.
